texts.preamble: An Application For Bail Under Section ... vs In Re:- Shyamapada Bera on 19 May, 2016 Author: Ashim Kumar Roy Bench: Ashim Kumar Roy ed Crm No.3705 of 2016 In the matter of an application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 16.05.2016 in connection with Moyna Police Station Case No.228 of 2015 dated 28.09.2015 under sections 272/273 of the Indian Penal Code read with West Bengal Act 42 of 1973 and sections 3/304/120B of the Indian Penal Code and section 46Aa of the Bengal Excise Act and section 16(3) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
texts.facts: It is the case, where consuming poison of ID liquor more than 30 persons died. Earlier twice the petitioner's prayer for bail was rejected on merit and lastly on March 18, 2016.
